modules.name: Aim Assist
modules.description: Smooth combat aim assist with FOV, range, part, and weapon filters.

modules.name: Anchor Macro
modules.description: Places, charges and blows up respawn anchors on right-click.

modules.name: Crystal Macro
modules.description: Breaks and places crystals while you hold right-click.

modules.name: Crystal Aura
modules.description: Places and breaks end crystals for the most damage.

modules.name: Triggerbot
modules.description: Hits the entity under the crosshair once the swing is charged, with a reaction delay.

modules.name: Kill Aura
modules.description: Attacks nearby targets without moving your camera.

modules.name: Shield Breaker
modules.description: Switches to an axe and hits when the targeted player is blocking with a shield.

modules.name: Mace
modules.description: Swaps to a mace for smash hits while falling, with an optional smash assist.

modules.name: Hover Totem
modules.description: Swaps a hovered inventory totem into the offhand or selected hotbar slot.

modules.name: FastXP
modules.description: Throws experience bottles every 100 ms while physical right-click is held.

modules.name: Auto Inventory Totem
modules.description: Refills the offhand totem after a pop, through the inventory or a hotbar swap.

modules.name: W Tap Recode
modules.description: Timed movement taps after a successful hit.

modules.name: Crystal Optimizer
modules.description: Removes crystals client-side as soon as your hit breaks them.

modules.name: Friend Guard
modules.description: Stops you from hitting players on your friends list.

modules.name: Spear Swap
modules.description: Swaps to your Lunge spear, lunges and swaps back.

modules.name: Legit Auto Tool
modules.description: Auto tool that only switches hotbar slots like a player.

modules.name: Auto Clicker
modules.description: Clicks the left and/or right mouse button at a randomised, human CPS.

modules.name: Auto Eat
modules.description: Eats hotbar or offhand food once hunger or health drops too low.

modules.name: Auto Replenish
modules.description: Refills a hotbar or offhand slot from the main inventory once it runs low.

modules.name: Auto Reconnect
modules.description: Reconnects to the last server after an unexpected disconnect.

modules.name: Anti Vanish
modules.description: Detects vanished players.

modules.name: Player Detection
modules.description: Detects when players are in the world.

modules.name: Auto Relog
modules.description: Relogs once when you go down to deepslate level.

modules.name: Anti Trap
modules.description: Allows you to escape from armor stands and chest minecarts.

modules.name: Air Stuck
modules.description: Freezes you in place, even mid-air.

modules.description: Mines your spawners into an ender chest when someone gets close.

modules.name: Staff List

modules.name: Netherite Finder
modules.description: Boxes Nether chunk sections hiding ancient debris.

modules.name: Render Distance Toggle
modules.description: Reloads chunks when you go below a Y level.

modules.description: Re-sets a home, RTPs away, then teleports back home.

modules.name: Trident Util
modules.description: Use tridents out of water and charge them faster.

modules.name: Quantum
modules.description: Finds player activity in resent chunks.

modules.name: Render Util
modules.description: Renders the chunks flagged by Quantum.

modules.name: Donut NoFall
modules.description: Take no fall damage on DonutSMP.

modules.name: Donut Speed Mine
modules.description: Finishes breaking blocks before the full break time.

modules.name: Amethyst Bypass

modules.name: Freecam
modules.description: Detached camera.

modules.name: Spam
modules.description: Spams specified messages in chat.

modules.name: Coord Snapper

modules.name: Chat Macro
modules.description: Sends chat messages or commands with a key press.

modules.name: Name Protect
modules.description: Shows aliases instead of player names on your screen.

modules.name: No Inv Leak

modules.name: Weather Notifier
modules.description: Shows an advancement-style toast when it starts raining.

modules.name: Sneak
